name: Adagio OLD
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #4-14: Shattering Golden Chains
description: A flock of animated paper birds flit about to the playful sounds of an invisible flute, played by the invisible janni Mehryar.
disable: DC 23 Crafting (trained) to create beautiful flying objects to complement the paper birds; DC 25 Acrobatics or DC 22 Performance (DC 18 Performance if using a flute) (trained) to perform along with the flute and paper birds (requires two successes); or one successful attack roll against the Invisible Mehryar (AC 23, DC 23 Perception to determine Mehryar's location)
reset: The trap deactivates and resets if no hostile creatures remain outside.
routine: (3 actions) On each of the trap's actions, the flock of paper birds attacks a different creature. On a successful hit, each target must attempt a DC 23 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, they take 1d6 Persistent,bleed Damage damage.

generalAbilities.name: Sforzando
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of the museum door without Fasiel's permission

Effect The trap rolls initiative as the paper birds attack. Wind and rain flurry through the area, applying a –2 circumstance penalty to ranged attacks and Perception checks, extinguishing non-magical fire, and impeding spells and abilities with the fire trait. Casters must succeed at a DC 6 Flat or the action is disrupted.
